description: Use it when a person names an old employer: the country the name points to, the employers we hold it may mean with a confidence from 0 to 1, and for researched employers what it became and its pension plan. Each fact has its source and read date.

country.description: Optional. The country worked in: a name, alias or ISO code. Matches are then taken from that country only.

include_offer.description: Optional, default false. Set true to add next_step, our report offer for this country. The offer the person sees comes from check_work_history (one offer for the whole history) or create_order_link.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

name.description: The employer name as the person knows it, ideally with legal form and city, for example "Shell Nederland B.V.".

previousNameCount.description: Optional. How many earlier names (a maiden or married name) the person worked under, from 0 to 5. Send the number only, never the names.

name: resolve_employer
title: Place an employer in a country
